column1: # Every row is a Go module path that is ALLOWED to be declared by more than
# one live go.mod, because both declarers are the SAME own-org submodule
# checked out at two locations: once directly under submodules/<name>/ (or
# constitution/), and once nested inside the submodules/claude-toolkit/**
# checkout (which vendors its own copies of the same own-org submodules).
# submodules/claude-toolkit is a submodule this project does NOT own and was
# explicitly instructed not to restructure or delete content from — the
# grandfather list is the correct scope per §11.4.124 (investigate before
# remove) + this finding's own instructions, mirroring the RS-13 pattern
# instead of masking the class with a blanket path exclusion.
# Grandfathered rows shrink ONLY (per §11.4.135 ratchet discipline): removing
# or de-duplicating a submodules/claude-toolkit/** copy removes its row here;
# a NEW duplicate module path appearing anywhere else in the tree is NEVER
# covered by this list and MUST still fail scripts/gates/unique_module_paths_gate.sh.
